ideas.name: Felt Desk Mat, Nordic Wool (modular tiles)
ideas.concept: Merino-blend wool felt desk mats in 4 Nordic-muted colours with laser-cut cable slot and magnetic-free modular add-on tiles.
ideas.problem_solved: Desk looks cluttered and cold; hard surfaces scratch and echo.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: web search budget exhausted and Firecrawl out of credits, so no trend signal was checked. Felt desk mats are widely sold; likely already growth-to-crowded.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own colour palette and modular tile system design; EU-felt supplier exclusivity.

ideas.name: Birch Cable-and-Dock Desk Tray
ideas.concept: CNC/laser birch plywood desk tray with a graded groove system for pens, phone, cable ends; flat-packed.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search possible; wooden desk organizers are known to be a large, crowded segment.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Registered design on groove geometry; FSC Nordic birch story.

ideas.name: Refillable Wool-Felt Kids Learning Mat and Play Pieces
ideas.concept: Felt play-scape (roads, landscape, weather) with replaceable themed felt packs sold as expansions.
ideas.problem_solved: Plastic-heavy, noisy toys; no quiet calm-play alternative.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search possible. Wooden/natural toy demand is commonly reported but not checked here. Needs EN71 and REACH testing.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Original illustrated designs (copyright) and expansion ecosystem with repeat purchase.

ideas.name: Ash-Wood Pencil and Craft Tool Roll Set for Kids
ideas.concept: Child-size ash hand tools and linen roll for woodworking/craft hobby kits with Nordic-designed projects.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search possible; screen-free hobby growth is a plausible but unchecked trend. EN71 testing needed; sharp parts raise liability.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Project cards and kit design as IP; supplier exclusivity.

ideas.name: Cork and Linen Desk Pad with Daylight-Angle Task Guide
ideas.concept: Cork desk pad with printed sun-path and daylight-positioning guide, using VELUX daylight know-how for desk placement near windows.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search possible. Angle plays to founders' daylight expertise; demand untested.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Founder daylight-science content as copy-resistant differentiator.

ideas.name: Recycled Aluminium Stackable Pen/Brush Cups with Birch Lids
ideas.concept: Spun/CNC recycled-aluminium cups stacking into a desk or art-table system with birch lids; kits for hobby painters.

ideas.name: Wool Felt Laptop and Tablet Sleeve with Pen Loop (Danish-style)
ideas.concept: Pressed wool felt sleeve in Nordic colourways with leather-alternative cork trim and replaceable accessory pouches.
ideas.problem_solved: Plain neoprene sleeves lack design; premium gap.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search possible; sleeve category is crowded, risk of flooded.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Colour and trim design; limited seasonal drops.
